test_base_function_forwarding: test that BaseWrapper correctly forwards reset, step, observation_spec, action_spec, load_state, save_state, and close to the wrapped environment
test_multiple_wrappers: test that chaining multiple BaseWrapper instances correctly propagates close calls through the wrapper chain to the base environment
test_raw_env: test that accessing raw_env on a doubly-wrapped environment returns the original unwrapped base environment
test_stats: test that BaseWrapper forwards the stats method call to the underlying environment and returns its stats dictionary
test_wrapped_stats: test that multiple custom wrappers each returning _wrapper_stats merge their stats with the base environment stats into a single dictionary
